source.name: FootyLogos: Rio Ave 2026-27 kits
source.quote: The front pairs Adidas branding with the club emblem and Lebull sponsorship.
source.note: Main sponsor across the front of the 2026-27 home shirt. The club's partners page (https://rioavefc.pt/parceiros/) lists Lebull under the heading 'Main Sponsor', and the club's launch photos (https://rioavefc.pt/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Equipamento1.jpg, on the club store product page https://rioavefc.pt/produto/camisola-principal-rafc-2026-27-copia/) show 'Lebull' across the chest.

source.name: Rio Ave FC: Grupo Lusíadas Saúde é o novo Parceiro Clínico do Rio Ave FC
source.quote: O Rio Ave FC e o Grupo Lusíadas Saúde formalizaram uma parceria institucional, através do qual os Hospitais Lusíadas Braga e Maia assumem o estatuto de parceiro clínico oficial do clube
source.note: Club announcement of the Lusíadas partnership for the 2026-27 season. Upper right chest of the 2026-27 home shirt, above the adidas logo, in the club's launch photos (https://rioavefc.pt/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Equipamento1.jpg; club store product page https://rioavefc.pt/produto/camisola-principal-rafc-2026-27-copia/).

source.name: Rio Ave FC: Cervezas San Miguel é o novo Premium Partner do Rio Ave FC
source.quote: A marca San Miguel, que já figura na manga esquerda da camisola oficial do Rio Ave FC na sua equipa principal
source.note: Left sleeve of the first team shirt. Announced April 2025 and still on the left sleeve of the 2026-27 home shirt in the club's launch photos (https://rioavefc.pt/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Equipamento1.jpg).

source.name: Footy Headlines: Rio Ave 26-27 Home Kit Released
source.quote: Rio Ave FC and Adidas have officially unveiled the club's new home kit for the 26-27 Liga Portugal season.
source.note: Kit maker, not a shirt sponsor in the front/back/sleeve sense.

summary: Adidas-made home shirt, launched 30 July 2026, with Lebull (Southern Stingray, S.A.) across the front, Lusíadas on the upper chest and San Miguel on the left sleeve. Not marked complete: no photo or text found documents the back of the home shirt or any shorts sponsor for 2026-27 (the club's store photos and launch images show only the front and sleeves).
